baseline_source: final schema36 candidate 922; production a2a_client.rs only

sources: Cargo.toml workspace MSRV and unsafe/lint policy
standards.judgement: existing authorization Seam, private immutable request snapshot, three getters; no new policy framework

spec.source: parent explicit request-facts patch scope; Draft RFC-0025 mapping is broader and remains unimplemented/unevaluated in part
spec.judgement: same prepared method, normalized URL/query and bounded serialized bytes provided to authenticated callback and consumed by HTTP builder; not policy enforcement

limits: Anonymous does not invoke a token provider
StaticA2aBearerToken and existing providers can ignore new facts
HTTP method alone does not distinguish JSON-RPC reads from writes
No all-header, DNS, TLS peer or system-proxy attestation
Clone can retain immutable body and URL after call; not zeroizing or aggregate-memory bounded
existing byte limit is serialized body length after serialization; not peak allocation or Vec-capacity bound
manual Debug preserves prior tenant/task/scope/attempt fields while redacting added URL/body
provider synchronous work and independently spawned work are trusted-host responsibilities
mark_dispatched remains conservative possible-send evidence, not proof of remote receipt
MSRV source assessment only; no Rust 1.88 compilation in this review
public network tests are outside the frozen production-only review
recommended_next_slice: one compiled host-owned provider example using exact destination/resource and bounded operation-specific body checks, PermissionDenied before business send, separate short-lived credential; no generic parser or new owner
